hyperAccuracyReceipt.reviewNotes: Checkpoint 003 is visually inspected learning evidence; keep incoming until hyper-accuracy review and matching rationale pass.
hyperAccuracyReceipt.nonCopyBoundary: Do not copy exact source visuals, brand names, color identity, imagery, icon systems, decorative geometry, or section order.

commercialPurpose: Open a multipurpose business site with clear solution copy while showing category breadth in a right-side menu stack.
purposeLayer: Hero frames the product as flexible across categories through abstract visual identity and visible category navigation.
anatomyLayer: Logo, left value proposition, CTA, small proof card, large abstract media panel, right vertical menu/category stack, and supporting teaser links.
hierarchyLayer: Headline first, abstract media second, category/menu stack third, CTA/proof card fourth.
gridRhythmLayer: Three-zone hero: left copy, center oversized abstract image, right category navigation stack on light grid background.
densityLimitLayer: Use one primary message, 1-2 CTA, 1 abstract media system, 4-7 category links, and 1 proof/help card.
originalityLayer: Learn three-zone multipurpose hero architecture; do not copy exact abstract image, category labels, blue/purple gradient, or grid texture.
usageRuleLayer: Use for multipurpose SaaS, agencies, business platforms, category-rich services, and template/product sites.
layoutGesture: light multipurpose hero with abstract media and side category stack
sectionSilhouette: left text column, giant central abstract image, right vertical menu rail
compositionTension: calm business copy balanced by loud abstract visual and navigational breadth
focalPath: headline to abstract image to category stack to CTA
negativeSpaceShape: light blue grid field around three distinct hero zones
depthLayering: flat light surface, abstract media depth, floating proof card/menu layers
moduleScaleVariation: large abstract media with compact category/link modules
breakoutBehavior: center media dominates and rises above surrounding text rails
antiCopyBoundary: Do not copy exact Alower abstract image, menu labels, gradient buttons, proof card, or grid decoration.
